QF.id: VB Fund Distribution and Channel Management_3

question.text: Which NISM certification is mandatory for a person to become a standard (full) mutual fund distributor, excluding the limited new-cadre and CPE-eligible exceptions?

explanation.text: The Logic: Per the workbook, the standard mutual fund distributor route requires passing the NISM Series V-A: Mutual Fund Distributors Certification and obtaining ARN/empanelment through AMFI. The Trap: CA or MBA qualifications, while useful, are not in themselves the NISM certification required. The SEBI Grade A Officer exam is unrelated to mutual fund distribution. Note: The workbook also describes a separate limited new-cadre allowed to sell a limited set of schemes after NISM Series V-B, and CPE eligibility for specified older/experienced persons; this question excludes those exceptions.
